Files (pending single feature commit by Main):
- src/program/generate.cpp: explicit --full-main-context-probe flag; exact input/capacity and zero-output-only gate; native pack check, each ID's vocabulary bounds; ordinary admission exceptions only for explicit mode; disabled elastic grow; isolated Prefill branch before MTP callback and kvg_ensure/ordinary n-1 run; runtime proof and poison/restore.
- include/strata/program/full_context_probe.hpp: independent MainCoverage helper with no successor accounting.
- tools/test_full_context_probe.cpp: meaningful helper tests for invalid extent/overflow/gaps/overlap, 262143+1 terminal-cell completion, 32x8192 completion. Existing CMake host test target already covers this file.
- include/strata/core/conversation_snapshot.hpp and src/core/conversation_state.cpp: explicit no-draft overloads for capture byte estimate/save/validate/restore. Existing draft-bearing API semantics remain unchanged. New image has exactly owned main QSA layers, real production checkpoint and runtime layer range; restored image validates all geometry/owned-layer/payload extents before transfer.
- docs/FULL_MAIN_CONTEXT_PROBE.ja.md first and English counterpart: exact purpose/admission/proof and pending runtime limits.

Actual flow/proof:
Native model + normal Session + positive fixed Prefill initialization -> direct Prefill::run(tokens.data(),262144,0,err). No MTP load/bind/prefill or record selector is required. No synthetic terminal ID exists. Completion callback follows production Prefill stream synchronization and accepts only gapless intervals [0,262144). Require actual PrefillStats.tokens=262144, callback end=262144 and stats.chunks=callback chunks=ceil(N/actual chunk). No tokens[N] access, output, sampling, verification, decode or post-restore inference occurs in this branch.
The whole main session must own all QSA and GDN layers and PLE, with exact262144 physical cells. Report input i32 FNV, model/pack/native route, actual chunk, KV precision/resident limit and each QSA's mode/pages/slots/host authoritative pools/pooled rows/bytes/fingerprint/final logical page. Capture and byte-compare every authoritative QSA payload including final physical page, rather than checking READY/capacity alone. Streamed mode1's full pinned host KV is distinct from bounded GPU residency. Production payload verifier checks all bytes. The full production path and synchronized callback establish issuance/consumption; this is not an independent numerical oracle or a per-layer write instrumentation counter.
Capture extent here follows view.ids.size() exactly. Do not infer an autoregressive N-1 count: report saved_logical_ids independently. Checkpoint includes GDN recurrence+conv, PLE, QSA tails/dead/block positions; normalize last-two PLE ID metadata from actual input at the completed extent. Running/index floats and separately stored half quant scales must be finite before poison. Packed q4 scale/fp16 KV numerical scans are not provided; their bytes are verified.
RAM estimate uses production actual payload allocation estimates, metadata and two extra checkpoint budgets plus 1MiB workspace reserve and >=2560MiB physical-free floor. Reject unknown/insufficient availability and arithmetic overflow before prefill; repeat immediately before capture. Snapshot single consumer is in-process restore only; no tensor/session file is written.
Poison running checkpoint via actual restore API and read it back: every named running vector must differ. Poison each full authoritative KV/index payload and bounded resident pool via existing checked copy/memset helper; each layer must produce exact byte-mismatch verifier failure. Restore via main-only production snapshot API in place, synchronize, byte-verify each payload and require identical fingerprints; resave and compare every running vector/PLE ID, then invalidate mode1 replacement map and synchronize. No inference follows restore. Run-level and outer diagnostic drain protect snapshots/Prefill-init failures; unknown GPU completion is fail-stop before free. Allocation exceptions become terminal diagnostic failures. No new unchecked copy or CPU/GPU atomic polling introduced.
Admission rejects MTP/spec, serve/batch/multi/split/pipeline/borrow/elastic/grow/dumps and debug dump environment (STRATA_PREFILL_DUMP_R_ALL, STRATA_QSA_DUMP, STRATA_IDX_FP16_CHECK). Ordinary bench.sh source remains untouched. Diagnostic elapsed/expert stats are context records only, not a performance benchmark.

Main pending commands (NOT executed; choose existing verified build recipe/toolchain, do not overlap current builds/GPU):
1. cmake --build <Main-qualified-build-directory> --target strata-generate full_context_probe_test
2. ctest --test-dir <Main-qualified-build-directory> -R '^full_context_probe_test$' --output-on-failure
3. CPU build/CTest covering existing conversation snapshot/checkpoint tests; qualify new main-only overload ownership and invalid geometry rejection on host as Main deems necessary.
4. After serialized build/test closure, run sourceLLVMv711's qualified native-copy binary with the ordinary known-good pack/native/PLE configuration, one GPU, --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768 --spec 0 --prefill-chunk 8192 --no-prefill-borrow --max-context 262144 --max-new 0 --tokens-file <SHA256-bound exact262144 ID fixture> --full-main-context-probe (omit --mtp and spec-output flags). Main supplies qualified artifact paths/environment/device supervision rather than invented paths.
Record exact source diff/binary/model/tokenizer/input hashes, backend/device/runtime/driver identities, mode1 actual pages/slots, each callback, every KV payload fingerprint/extent, finite checks, running bytes/fingerprints, restore status, exit and fresh fault findings. Reject 262143 and 262145 inputs, nonzero output, MTP/spec/serve/multi/borrow/auto-chunk. CPU helper success alone does not qualify physical endpoint. No speed/quality claim.

Limitations/pending:
No compiler or runtime result exists for this implementation. Current intended mode1/int8/resident32768/native/sourceLLVMv711 route needs Main build+CPU+GPU qualification. Captured-state equality tests restoration against the just-captured state, not prediction correctness/RoPE/attention numerical equivalence. FNV is a corruption fingerprint, not cryptographic source/input identity. Host MemAvailable is not cgroup/job-limit telemetry; Main must run on known unconstrained host or admit effective job limits separately. Model/session allocations precede snapshot RAM preflight; no new VRAM peak estimate is claimed. Compact evidence must be committed by Main before boundary/resume; no active artifacts were cleaned or retired, so no deletion manifest was needed.
